zh: 先求出所有会议覆盖的时间并集，它是一些互不相交的区间；再从中扣掉一段免打扰区间即可。区间是半开的，首尾相接的区间要合并。
按开始时间排序后线性合并：与当前段相交或相接就延长，否则开新段。得到并集后，每一段减去免打扰区间最多只会剩下左、右两块。
排序后合并（a ≤ 当前段结束时并入）；对每个合并段 [a,b)：若 b≤ds 或 a≥de，原样保留；否则若 a<ds 保留 [a,ds)，若 b>de 保留 [de,b)；输出段数和各段起止。
en: First compute the union of all meeting times, which is a set of disjoint intervals; then subtract the do-not-disturb interval. Intervals are half-open, and touching intervals must be merged.

After sorting by start time, merge linearly: extend the current segment when the next interval overlaps or touches it, otherwise start a new segment. Once the union is known, subtracting the do-not-disturb interval leaves at most a left piece and a right piece of each segment.

Sort and merge (merge when a <= the current segment's end); for each merged segment [a, b): if b <= ds or a >= de, keep it as is; otherwise keep [a, ds) when a < ds and [de, b) when b > de; print the number of segments and their start and end values.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First sort by start and merge the covered intervals, then subtract the do-not-disturb interval from each segment, keeping the non-empty left and right parts.

## Correctness

After sorting, an interval that overlaps or touches the current segment makes their union a single segment; otherwise a new segment must be started. Once the full union of meetings is known, the difference with the do-not-disturb interval can only leave its left part and its right part; keeping every non-empty part gives exactly the required set of times.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
